title: Interior product of a unit simple (n+1)-vector with a 1-covector lies in its plane (supplied step 3)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, ξ ∈ Λ_{n+1}(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P (n+1)) and α an n-covector on ℝ^P. For a 1-covector β put β∧α := alternatizeUncurryFin(β.smulRight α), i.e. (β∧α)(v₀,…,v_n) = Σ_i (−1)^i β(v_i) α(v₀,…,v̂_i,…,v_n). With e_i := EuclideanSpace.single i 1 and e_i♭ := innerSL ℝ e_i, put v := Σ_{i<P} ξ(e_i♭∧α)·e_i. Then (1) ξ(β∧α) = β(v) for every continuous linear β : ℝ^P → ℝ; and (2) if ξ is a unit orientation of a linear subspace Q (IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q), then v ∈ Q.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ξ : MultiVector P (n + 1)) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), (∀ β : Euclid P →L[ℝ] ℝ, ξ (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (β.smulRight α)) = β (∑ i : Fin P, ξ (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((innerSL ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) : Euclid P)).smulRight α)) • (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) : Euclid P))) ∧ ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → (∑ i : Fin P, ξ (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((innerSL ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) : Euclid P)).smulRight α)) • (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) : Euclid P)) ∈ Q
